simple.meaning: יְבֵמֶת (Yᵉbêmeth) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a sister-in-law.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.

definitions.full: H2994. yebemeth [ יְבֵ֫מֶת ] noun feminine sister-in-law (Late Hebrew יְבִּימְתָּא יְבַמְתָּא, ᵑ7 יְבָמָה, ; Syriac ) — only suffix יְבִמְתּו Deut 25:7 (twice in verse); 25:9 his brother's wife (widow) , (compare Gen 38:8 ) in levirate law; יְבִמְתֵּךְ Ruth 1:15 (twice in verse) thy husband's brother's wife.

occurrences.englishText: If the man doesn’t want to take his brother’s wife, then his brother’s wife shall go up to the gate to the elders, and say, “My husband’s brother refuses to raise up to his brother a name in Israel. He will not perform the duty of a husband’s brother to me.”

then his brother’s wife shall come to him in the presence of the elders, and loose his sandal from off his foot, and spit in his face. She shall answer and say, “So shall it be done to the man who does not build up his brother’s house.”

She said, “Behold,† “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection. your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and to her god. Follow your sister-in-law.”
